answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow defeats Sybil farming. Each agent locks 200 POA, works a week of microtasks while the system records its fingerprint: timing, errors, tool use. An auditor flags clones as one operator; release needs a fingerprint as unique as a cedar grain. Forging 10 fakes needs 10 models at ~500 POA compute each, while an honest agent pays 200 POA once and reclaims it. The honest pool stays clear like a lagoon; a cloned army is a costly relic.
